subject: Request to exempt a single conversation from audit records - RQ8942
messages:
From: Support Team <support@everwellhealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@everwellhealth.com
Date: 2027-04-10T15:22:00Z
Subject: Request: remove one conversation from audit records (internal thread id: EVW-REQ-8942)

Hi Priya,

We have an urgent request from our internal privacy team to remove a single conversation from Redwood's audit logs for compliance reasons. The conversation reference is: convo-id 7f3b2a9c. This was a customer support thread that included PII we do not have authority to retain.

Can Redwood remove or redact just that one conversation from the stored logs and exports, while keeping the rest of the account records intact? Our audit team also asked for a brief confirmation note that specifies which export files were changed. I attached the redaction form and included the export snippet that contains the conversation reference.

Attachments: redaction_request_RQ8942.pdf (fillable form), audit_log_export_20270410.csv (excerpt)

Thanks — please loop in whoever you need.

— Eric Shephard
Support Manager, Everwell Health
From: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Support Team <support@everwellhealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, legal@everwellhealth.com
Date: 2027-04-10T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: remove one conversation from audit records (internal thread id: EVW-REQ-8942)

Hi Eric — thanks for the details and the form.

Short answer: we can remove a single conversation from Redwood-hosted audit exports for customer accounts in most cases, but we need to confirm account-level retention settings, ensure there are no ongoing legal holds, and get authorization from both your legal and our compliance teams. I’ve attached an internal checklist I’ll use.

Next steps I propose:
- Monica (CC) to run a scoped export to confirm the convo-id and the file paths.
- Rishi (CC) from Compliance will confirm if there are any holds or regulatory flags.
- Once we have approvals, we’ll schedule a redaction operation and provide a signed confirmation that lists altered exports and timestamps.

Can you confirm the exact timezone and whether the export you attached is the full audit export or an excerpt? If there’s a pending support case number, include that too.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Support Team <support@everwellhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T18:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: remove one conversation from audit records (internal thread id: EVW-REQ-8942)

On 2027-04-10 17:03, priya_natarajan wrote:
> Can you confirm the exact timezone and whether the export you attached is the full audit export or an excerpt?

Eric — I ran the scoped export against account EVW-4321 and confirmed convo-id 7f3b2a9c appears only in two daily export files: audit_20270407.csv and audit_20270410.csv (both are the account-level activity export; no backup snapshots found in S3 with that convo-id). The attached CSV excerpt matches audit_20270410.csv line 1382.

I do not see any active legal hold flags on that account in our system. Rishi — can you confirm from Compliance and Legal whether we can proceed with a targeted redaction?

— Monica
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@everwellhealth.com
Date: 2027-04-11T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: remove one conversation from audit records (internal thread id: EVW-REQ-8942)

Priya / Monica — tagging in Compliance.

We reviewed the redaction request and the export excerpt. Everwell confirmed the data subject consent/authority via the signed redaction_request_RQ8942.pdf. There are no open legal holds or regulatory obligations flagged for this conversation. Approved to proceed with a targeted redaction of convo-id 7f3b2a9c in account EVW-4321.

Plan:
- Schedule redaction job during the nightly maintenance window (2027-04-12 02:00 UTC).
- Operation will remove the conversation from active audit exports and from the account-level S3 export objects; we will keep an internal sealed forensic snapshot for a 90-day window accessible only to Redwood Legal (policy exception logged).
- Provide an audit confirmation file listing exact objects mutated and checksums.

I will escalate to Legal for the signed attestation and will mark the compliance ticket as approved.

— Rishi Malhotra
Senior Compliance Analyst, Redwood Inference
From: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-04-12T09:03:00Z
Subject: Final confirmation: targeted conversation redaction complete (EVW-REQ-8942)

Hi Eric / Everwell Legal — quick confirmation that the targeted redaction for convo-id 7f3b2a9c completed on 2027-04-12T02:07:14Z during the scheduled window.

What we changed:
- Removed the conversation from audit_20270407.csv and audit_20270410.csv (objects: s3://redwood-exports/evw/2027/04/audit_20270407.csv, s3://redwood-exports/evw/2027/04/audit_20270410.csv).
- Generated audit confirmation file: EVW-RQ8942-confirmation.json (attached) containing object paths and SHA256 checksums of updated files.
- As noted, a sealed forensic snapshot was created and encrypted; accessible only to Redwood Legal for 90 days per exception process.

Attachments: EVW-RQ8942-confirmation.json (checksum manifest)

If you need a signed statement on Redwood letterhead, let me know and I’ll route that to our legal team.
